call_purpose: You called because, after connecting your payment gateway, your customers were not getting the order confirmation email after they bought.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product and saved it, and a test order you placed delivered the confirmation email to your inbox.

covered.text: We explained that the default sender name on the email can be changed under Email settings, Sender name. This is not yet done.

customer_next_steps.text: You mentioned that you planned to change the sender name to your brand name yourself.
